items.title: Join ACMI in Celebrating International Migrants Day 2026!
items.author: ZHIPING
items.description:
Hey Hwa Chong! Remember the cards hand-written by us on Friday the 23rd of October for our Singaporean migrant workers? ACMI is back again with another opportunity for volunteering!
With migrant workers being such a core part of our nation, it is hard to imagine how many subsidies they are being left out of, which they desperately need. You can show your support by joining ACMI in celebrating International Migrants Day 2026 with an afternoon of friendship, creativity and meaningful connections with our migrant brothers!
Volunteers will engage migrant workers through a fun and simple bead bracelet-making activity, creating opportunities for conversation and cultural exchange. Volunteers will also distribute handmade bracelets and cards lovingly prepared by Hwa Chong students during the Journey With Hwa Chong activity on 23 October 2026.
No prior experience is needed - just a friendly attitude and an open heart! Together, let's celebrate our migrant brothers, forge new friendships and foster a stronger sense of belonging in our community.
The event will be held at Caritas Agape Village at Toa Payoh on December 13, Sunday.
Sign up now at:
https://www.giving.sg/volunteer/opportunity/community-engagement--befriending-with-migrant-workers--international-migrants-day-2026
Learn more by clicking on this video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LEBCEF68Dq8&source_ve_path=NzY3NTg&embeds_referring_euri=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.giving.sg%2F
